stemMd: A fair coin is tossed four times. What is the probability of at least one tail?
explanationMd: Use the complement: no tail means four heads, probability $(1/2)^4=1/16$. Subtract from 1 to get 15/16.

distractorRationale.b: Uses the probability for only one toss.
distractorRationale.c: Counts only two tosses in the complement.
